name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260626-0002] [3.6] [Feature] Task Manager UI task search by task id
description: Added a task-search bar to the Task Manager UI (resources/templates/task_manager.html), positioned ABOVE the status tabs, that locates a task by its id. Submitting a query (Search button or Enter) matches task ids case-insensitively: an exact id match takes precedence, otherwise a unique substring match is accepted, while an ambiguous substring match (more than one task) prompts the user to enter a more specific id. When a task is found, the UI switches the active status tab to the matched task's normalized status, renders that status's list, selects and scrolls the matched row into view, and opens the task's details in the details pane; a no-match query reports an inline message and leaves the current view unchanged. Implemented with new JS helpers searchTask/findTaskById/activateStatusTab/initSearch (wired into the init IIFE alongside initTabs), a .search-bar markup block and CSS, reusing the existing normalizeStatus/renderTable/showDetail/refreshRows/setMsg logic. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.14 and architecture feature 11.2.2 (resources.templates.task_manager) recording the previously un-architected single-page UI template. New test test_task_manager_template_has_task_search in test/tests/base/task_manager.py. Build tests verified: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260624-0003] [5.3.1.1.4] [Feature] README.md rewritten as an app overview, with guardrails against changelog drift
description: Rewrote the top-level README.md from a long per-release 'Highlights' changelog into a current-state overview of the app (what it does, project structure, and how to set up / run / instantiate / pull base updates / build via the Task Manager), per build/instructions/base.md step 4e which requires README.md to describe current functionality/capability rather than the evolution of the software. To prevent it from drifting back into a changelog, hardened the finalization instructions: build/instructions/base.md (deployment step 4e) and build/instructions/app.md now explicitly forbid Highlights/Changelog/Release Notes/What's New sections, release enumeration, and date/version-stamped headings in README.md, and require editing the overview in place (per-release history stays only in docs/readme/{base,app}.md and build/updates/{base,app}.json). Added an advisory guard test test.tests.base.base.test_readme_overview_only (architecture feature 5.3.1.1.4) that scans README.md for changelog markers (Highlights/Changelog/Release/What's New headings, or two-or-more date/version-stamped headings) and reports WARN rather than FAIL; it is registered as the build-phase test build_readme_overview_only in test/config/base.json so it runs with the build tests but never breaks the build (fail_on=["FAIL"]). Added requirement BASE-REQ-013.8. Verified: build.py build phase 2/2 0 failures (exit 0), deployment test 25/25, app run 0 WARN/0 ERROR; the guard PASSes on the rewritten README and WARNs on a synthetic changelog README.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260622-0004] [3.6] [Feature] Task Manager UI - sort and filter the task list by each column (ID, Title, Type, Priority)
description: Made the previously-static Task Manager task list (resources/templates/task_manager.html) sortable and filterable by each of its columns. Every column header (ID, Title, Type, Priority) is now clickable and cycles its sort through three states -- none -> ascending -> descending -- showing a triangle indicator for the active sort column and direction; only one column sorts at a time. The Priority column sorts by severity rank (Critical > High > Medium > Low) via PRIORITY_RANK rather than alphabetically, while ID/Title/Type sort naturally (numeric-aware, case-insensitive localeCompare). A filter row under the headers restricts the rows: ID and Title filter by case-insensitive substring text inputs, while Type and Priority filter by exact value chosen from dropdowns populated (populateColumnFilters/fillFilterSelect) with the distinct values present in the task list, each with an 'All' option that clears the filter. Sorting and filtering operate within the currently selected status tab and combine (filters first via getVisibleTasks, then the sort); when active filters exclude every task in the status the list shows 'No tasks match the current filters.' (distinct from an empty status). New JS getVisibleTasks/compareCol/cycleSort/updateSortIndicators/populateColumnFilters/fillFilterSelect/initColumnControls, wired through initColumnControls() at startup; no server-side change required. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.13 and test test_task_manager_template_has_column_sorting_and_filtering in test/tests/base/task_manager.py. Validation: 9/9 task_manager template tests pass; node --check + a logic harness confirmed the sort/filter behavior.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260624-0001] [3.6] [Feature] Each task runs in its own dedicated git worktree (bare-repo {APP}/<branch> layout)
description: Converted the branch-per-task workflow from in-place 'git checkout' to a bare shared object store with every branch -- including main -- checked out as its own peer git worktree under a single {APP} container ({APP}/.bare shared store, {APP}/main for main, {APP}/<task-id> for each task). The previous in-place model could hold only one branch per working tree, so concurrent task agents stomped on each other; dedicated worktrees give each task its own isolated checkout that shares the object store. scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 adds a -Worktree parameter that materialises (or reuses) the task's worktree and runs the worker session inside it (the legacy in-place checkout is retained as a defensive fallback). scripts/task_manager.py adds _worktree_root (always the {APP} container, i.e. the parent of the main working tree) and _worktree_path_for_task (always {APP}/<task-id>) -- the worktree location is FIXED and not configurable; _build_copilot_prompt/_build_review_prompt take a workspace_override so the worker's {workspace_root} points at its worktree, and _start_copilot_for_task passes -Worktree and records the worktree on worker_session. The task's worktree is dissolved together with its branch when the task reaches Done. Requirement BASE-REQ-014.9 and instructions build/instructions/base.md and task.md updated to the bare {APP}/<branch> model with the fixed worktree location. Tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py add worktree path/root resolution, launcher wiring, an end-to-end worktree-creation test, and a workspace-override prompt test. Build tests verified: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260626-0001] [3.7] [Feature] Status-sync commits only the task ledger, isolated from the worker's working tree
description: Fixed the Task Manager status-sync so applying a queued status-update request commits and pushes ONLY the task ledger (build/tasks/<app>.json) in complete isolation from the worker's primary working tree. Previously the headless status-inbox sync ran scripts/sync_task_repo.ps1 in the shared working tree -- which, while a worker is active, is checked out on the worker's task/<id> branch with uncommitted code/spec/test changes -- committing the ledger there and running 'git pull --rebase --autostash', which could sweep/push worker code ahead of the Ready/Deployed approval gate, drop uncommitted worker changes via autostash, and mix ledger-only commits with unrelated worker changes (evidence: BASE-TASK-260624-0002 commits 1177fa3/87181bd swept build/requirements and resources/templates, and an autostash dropped a test-file edit). Rewrote scripts/sync_task_repo.ps1 to read the server-updated ledger from the primary tree and apply the commit inside a dedicated, reusable DETACHED git worktree (<git-common-dir>/baseapp-ledger-sync) built from the latest origin/<branch> tip: it path-scopes 'git add -- <ledger>', commits, and pushes to refs/heads/<branch>, rebasing only the single ledger commit inside that isolated worktree on a non-fast-forward; it never runs 'git add -A'/'commit -a' or any working-tree autostash/rebase, so the worker's primary tree is never staged, stashed, rebased, or pushed. Added a -Branch parameter (default current HEAD; the headless status-inbox sync passes the configured ledger branch). scripts/task_manager.py adds _resolve_ledger_branch (reads APP.TASK_MANAGER.ledger_branch, default 'main') and a branch argument on _sync_task_store_to_git forwarded as -Branch, wired from _apply_status_request_file. config/base.json adds APP.TASK_MANAGER.ledger_branch = 'main'. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.12, updated architecture feature 3.7, added test feature 5.3.1.7.2, and added the regression test test_sync_task_repo_isolates_ledger_commit_from_worker_tree in test/tests/base/task_manager.py. Build tests verified: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260624-0002] [3.6] [Feature] Task Manager UI - independent scrolling for the task list and task details with a resizable split
description: Reworked the Task Manager UI (resources/templates/task_manager.html) so the task list and the selected task's details are two fixed, vertically-stacked blocks that each scroll independently, instead of rendering the details below the list inside a single page-level scroll. The page body is now a full-height flex column with hidden overflow (body height:100vh + overflow:hidden; main flex:1 + min-height:0), and the content area holds a new .split column containing a .list-pane (wraps the task table, overflow:auto), a draggable .split-divider gutter, and a .detail-pane (wraps the detail panel plus a placeholder, overflow:auto); the panes use flex-grow 60/40. A new initSplit() JS function uses pointer events on the divider to adjust the flex ratio (clamped 12%-88%), persists the chosen ratio in localStorage['tm_split_ratio'], and resets to the default 0.6 on double-click. showDetail()/hideDetail() toggle a #detail-empty placeholder ('Select a task above to view its details.') and reset the details pane scroll to top when a task is opened. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.11; no architecture change (the change lives inside the existing task_manager.html template under scripts.task_manager / Feature 3.6). New test test_task_manager_template_has_resizable_split_panes in test/tests/base/task_manager.py. Build tests verified: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260624-0001] [3.6.10/3.6.13/6.3.6] [Feature] Durable file-store task status channel, per-agent MCP enqueue server, and live MCP health check
description: Added a durable, file-store task status channel so workers (which may run on their own branch) never edit/commit the task ledger directly: an agent requests every ledger change (status transitions and progress comments) by atomically writing (write-then-rename) a {"TASKS":[{id,status,comments}]} request — per build/tasks/update.template.json — into a configurable 'task status store' (APP.TASK_MANAGER.status_queue/request_polling_frequency/enable). The Task Manager (scripts/task_manager.py) is the sole writer: _status_inbox_watcher (a daemon started by run(), skippable via --no-status-inbox) continuously samples the store at the configured interval and _process_status_inbox applies each request to a freshly loaded ledger by id via _apply_task_update/_apply_task_fields (lists combine, dicts update recursively, scalars overwrite — no generic deep-merge), persists it, then stages/commits/pushes to main headlessly, moving each request to processed/ or failed/ exactly once (idempotent, restart-safe). Each worker is additionally given a per-agent stdio MCP server (scripts/status_queue_mcp.py — zero-dependency newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; tool enqueue_status_update(status?, comment?); pure helpers build_status_update_request/write_request_atomically) wired in by scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 via the Copilot CLI --additional-mcp-config hook (_write_agent_mcp_config + the launcher's new -McpConfig param); the direct file write remains the documented fallback and the dequeue side stays a direct filesystem read (the enqueue server is never on the critical path). Task-manager directories are config-driven via APP.TASK_MANAGER: status_queue (request queue), prompt_store (worker {task.id}.md prompts and per-agent .mcp.json), and result_store (agent HTML work summaries); _build_copilot_prompt renders {status_store}/{result_store} placeholders. Added a live aggregate MCP health check (utils/testutils.py::mcp_server_status, registered as live_mcp_server_status, every 60s): it discovers every configured server from the per-agent .mcp.json files in prompt_store (falling back to the canonical server when idle), probes each via a fresh subprocess initialize handshake, and logs to the console how many servers are up/down plus the active rate (up/total) and pending queue depth — GOOD when none are down, WARN when exactly one is down, FAIL when more than one is down. Added a distinct GOOD log type (type #5 for testing) rendered in light green for test output (test/config/base.json test_logger; LIGHTGREEN color + TST009 message code), without changing the application logger's GOOD color. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.10, solution feature 3.6.10, and architecture nodes 3.6.13 (+3.6.13.1/.2/.3), 3.6.14, and 6.3.6, plus tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py. Instructions build/instructions/base.md and task.md document the request-via-store workflow with enqueue_status_update as the primary mechanism.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260624-0001] [3.6.9] [Feature] Branch-per-task workflow, Deployed status, and new Task Manager status tabs
description: Introduced a one-short-lived-branch-per-task workflow plus a richer task lifecycle. Agent instructions (build/instructions/base.md, app.md, task.md, task-review.md) now require each task to be worked on its own ad-hoc 'task/<id>' branch off main (never on main directly); the branch is created by the launcher scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 (via its new -TaskBranch parameter) — not by the agent — after verifying whether the branch already exists and whether starting a worker is necessary. scripts/task_manager.py adds _branch_name_for_task and _task_branch_exists; _start_copilot_for_task passes -TaskBranch for work-mode workers and records the branch on the worker session; the /api/tasks/<id>/start-agent endpoint returns HTTP 409 (requires_confirmation) when a branch already exists unless the request opts in via confirm_existing_branch, and the UI prompts the engineer and retries on confirmation. The lifecycle gains a 'Deployed' status between 'Ready' and the terminal 'Done' (ToDo -> InProgress -> Ready -> Deployed -> Done): 'Deployed' = finalized and pushed to the task's own branch (not yet merged); 'Done' = fully integrated into main (branch merged and dissolved, integration engineer supervising), keeping 'Done' terminal for backward compatibility. The Task Manager UI (resources/templates/task_manager.html) adds status tabs in the order ToDo, InProgress, Specified, Ready, Deployed, Approved, Done, plus the existing Deleted tab and a new pathological 'Other' catch-all tab that holds any task whose status is not one of the recognized statuses (unrecognized statuses normalize to 'Other' instead of collapsing into 'ToDo'). Each new status has a tab, count badge, badge styling, normalization synonyms, and (for the lifecycle statuses) create/edit dropdown options. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.9 and solution feature 3.6.9, plus tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260622-0005] [3.6.7] [Feature] Task Manager UI - allow task deletion with Deleted status
description: Added task deletion to the Task Manager. Backend (scripts/task_manager.py): _delete_task plus a DELETE /api/tasks/<id> endpoint soft-delete a task to the 'Deleted' status, or permanently remove it when it is already deleted; _update_task now restricts deleted tasks to status-only changes, and the start-agent and comments endpoints reject deleted tasks with HTTP 409. UI (resources/templates/task_manager.html): added a 'Deleted' status tab with badge/count, a 'Delete Task'/'Delete Permanently' button in the detail panel, Deleted status styling/option and normalization, and disabling of all edit/comment/worker controls for deleted tasks except status. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.7, architecture feature 3.6.7, and tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260623-0002] [3.6.8] [Feature] Task Manager UI - auto-sync selected app's tasks with Git on startup
description: The Task Manager now automatically synchronizes the currently selected app's task file with its own linked git repository on startup before serving the UI. scripts/task_manager.py::_sync_selected_app_on_startup runs synchronously during run() (blocking until the sync completes) so the displayed task list reflects the synced state; _sync_task_store_to_git gained a wait flag (wait=True opens a visible console window and blocks until the sync finishes, while the manual Sync Git button keeps the async visible-window behavior). The sync is skipped when no repo is linked and failures are reported but never block startup; a new --no-startup-sync CLI flag disables it. Hardened scripts/sync_task_repo.ps1 to rebase with 'git pull --rebase --autostash' and abort the push if the rebase fails. Also fixed Copilot worker/review console window titles: a TaskWindowTitleKeeper thread in scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 continuously re-asserts the title (Win32 SetConsoleTitle) so the CLI's auto-generated name can't stick, and _start_copilot_for_task names each window '<title> (<id>)'. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.8, architecture features 3.6.8/3.7, and tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260623-0003] [3.6] [Feature] Add Ready task state between InProgress and Done with review activation
description: Introduced a 'Ready' task state in the ToDo -> InProgress -> Ready -> Done lifecycle. Updated build/instructions/base.md, app.md, and task.md so the Copilot worker sets a task to Ready (not Done) when finished and only finalizes/commits/pushes/sets Done after explicit engineer approval. Added the build/instructions/task-review.md review prompt template. In scripts/task_manager.py: each launched worker now records its session (pid + console window title) on the task; added _process_alive, _activate_copilot_window, and _build_review_prompt helpers and a POST /api/tasks/{id}/activate endpoint that re-focuses the existing Copilot window when traceable or starts a dedicated review session otherwise. scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 now sets a deterministic console window title. resources/templates/task_manager.html adds a Ready tab/badge, s-ready styling, Ready dropdown options, Ready status normalization, and a status-aware 'Review Changes' action button. Added requirement BASE-REQ-014.6 and architecture features 3.6.5/3.6.6, plus new prep tests in test/tests/base/task_manager.py.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260621-0005] [3.6] [Feature] Task Manager UI dropdowns now show all options on open
description: Fixed the Create Task and Edit Task forms in resources/templates/task_manager.html so the Type and Priority controls display all available options immediately when opened. These were previously datalist-backed <input> fields, which browsers filter against the current value and only reveal matching options once the user starts typing. Replaced them with native <select> dropdowns (matching the existing Status control), removing the dl-type/dl-prio/dl-type2/dl-prio2 datalists. The free-form Author datalist is unchanged. Existing JS that sets e-type/e-priority values on edit continues to work against the selects.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260619-0002] [3.6] [Feature] Task Manager UI author dropdown and auto-creation comment
description: Added an Author dropdown to the Create Task form in resources/templates/task_manager.html. The dropdown (datalist-backed input) is populated from all unique comment authors across loaded tasks, sorted alphabetically, and defaults to the last author alphabetically while allowing free-form entry. Added _local_user() helper in scripts/task_manager.py using getpass.getuser(). Modified _create_task() to always prepend an auto 'Task created: <title>' comment attributed to the selected/local author. Author is included in the CLI equivalent preview. Updated BASE-REQ-014.2 in build/requirements/base.json.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260619-0001] [6.1.9.25] [Bug] Logger console output renders escape sequences
description: Added _decode_escapes() helper to Logger in utils/baseutils.py. Converts literal escape sequences (\n, \t, \r) into real control characters when building the console_event values in log(). Console output now renders newlines and tabs correctly while the stored log entry and CSV keep the original literal text.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260619-0003] [3.6] [Bug] Copilot CLI worker launched in interactive mode with write permissions
description: Fixed scripts/launch_task_agent.ps1 to start Copilot in true interactive mode with -i, set the workspace with -C, add the repo root to allowed paths with --add-dir, and enable autonomous workspace edits with --allow-all. Resolves the issue where the worker was launched via non-interactive stdin flow and could not request or auto-grant write permissions.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260609-0004] [3.6, 5.3.1.7] [Feature] Local web-based task manager UI
description: Added scripts/task_manager.py (Features 3.6, 3.6.1, 3.6.2): a stdlib-only local HTTP server with a single-page web UI that reads and writes build/tasks/base.json directly. Supports creating tasks (title, description, type, priority, status, initial comment), editing any field in-place, and appending comments. Task list displays with a status summary bar; all changes persist immediately to disk. Added prep test test_task_manager_interface (Feature 5.3.1.7.1) with 6 criteria covering store load, create/persist, update fields, append comment, HTTP UI round-trip, and HTTP endpoint persistence. Also fixed HTML template path resolution in utils/baseutils.py (_save_output_artifact now joins relative template paths against self.base_dir), scripts/instantiate.py and scripts/pullbase.py (resolve_template_path no longer inserts a spurious 'config/' segment), and test/tests/base/base.py (ArchitectureAlignmentTest._resolve_template_path). HTML_TEMPLATE in config/base.json is now the project-root-relative value 'resources/templates/dataset_table.html'. Added BASE-REQ-014 and architecture features 3.6, 3.6.1, 3.6.2, 5.3.1.7, 5.3.1.7.1. Build tests: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260618-0002] [6.1.4.1] [Feature] Modify config file loading with skip filters
description: Enhanced Config.__init__ in utils/baseutils.py to skip loading config JSON files based on two criteria: (1) files starting with underscore (_) or dot (.) are skipped by name before opening; (2) files containing LOADME: false in their JSON dict are skipped after parsing. This allows users to disable config overrides without deleting files, and follow naming conventions to exclude temporary or development configs. Alphabetical load order is preserved for all active files.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260616-0001] [6.1.9.23] [Feature] Group logger messages by TYPE and save structured logs
description: Added Logger.print_summary(). AppManager.run() now prints only a concise ERROR summary at close in summary mode. Grouped logs are stored through existing logs_by_type_json/logs_by_type_html outputs sourced from LOGS with per-type conversions. Expanded post test test_logs_by_type (Feature 5.3.1.3.8) to validate per-type output files. Build tests passed: 1 run, 0 failures.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260611-0002+] [6.1.9] [Feature] Console output formatting improvements
description: Improved Logger console output: removed type_key from default console_items; message_code column header renamed to CODE; column widths expand dynamically as wider values appear; all columns use ljust; last column value printed without trailing padding. Added BASE006 (Loaded input {input_key} ({source}) into RESULTS.{target_name}) and updated load_data() call site to use it with populate=True. Added populate=True to both BASE003 call sites in _save_output_artifact.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260611-0002] [6.1.9.18] [Feature] Logger populate message text from data
description: Added populate=False parameter to Logger.log(). When True, {key} placeholders in the looked-up message text are replaced with matching values from the data dict before storing or printing. Placeholder wrappers are configurable via message_wrappers=('{','}') on Logger (default: curly braces). Added _populate_message() helper. Updated message texts in logger.csv and base.csv with placeholders, and updated all matching call sites in baseutils.py, pullbase.py, and instantiate.py to pass populate=True.

name: [BaseApp] [3.2.15, 3.2.16] [Feature] drop.json entries without a target delete the source
description: Extended load_drop_entries (3.2.15) to accept drop entries where 'target' is absent or null. Extended drop_deprecated_paths (3.2.16) to delete source files/directories outright when target is None, instead of requiring a target path. Updated drop.json with a delete-only entry for build/_workflow (no target).

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260609-0007] [Architecture] Remove build/_workflow folder
description: Removed build/_workflow/ folder and its feature 10.5 (build._workflow / build._workflow.base) from build/architecture/base.json. Added build/_workflow to drop.json so instantiated apps remove the folder on next pull.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260610-0001] [6.1.4] [Feature] Add config/local.json local override placeholder
description: Added config/local.json as a gitignored placeholder for local config overrides. The file is deployed once via resources/manifests/once.json and deep-merged on top of base.json + app.json at load time by Config (6.1.4) without any code changes. Added BASE-REQ-001.5, architecture feature 2.2, and prep test test_local_config_override (5/5 PASS).

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260610-0003] [6.1.9] [Bug] Wrap os.remove on old log files with try-except
description: Wrapped os.remove() in Logger._remove_old_files() with try/except OSError so that permission errors or file-in-use conditions do not propagate and trip the app. Deletion count only increments on success.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260610-0002] [6.1.6] [HTML] Improve plain text rendering in HTML outputs
description:
Added HtmlDoc._format_text() to improve plain-text cell rendering: splits on actual newline characters (converting to
), and inserts
before mid-text # section markers. _render_cell() now delegates to _format_text() for plain strings instead of calling html.escape() directly. Long prompts, instructions, and structured text are now significantly more readable in HTML output reports.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260609-0005] [3.1.12, 3.1.6, 3.1.13] [Instantiation] Allow instantiate to override app config values during instantiation
description: Added --overrides CLI argument to instantiate.py accepting a JSON file path or inline JSON string. Added load_overrides() (Feature 3.1.12) to parse the argument. Added _deep_merge() (Feature 3.1.13) for recursive dict merging. Updated populate_app_config() (Feature 3.1.6) to accept optional overrides dict and deep-merge it into config/app.json after setting APP_NAME. Added INST010 and INSTW10 message codes. Added BASE-REQ-008.6 with 4 breakdown items. Added architecture features 3.1.12 and 3.1.13. Added prep test test_instantiate_config_overrides (Feature 5.3.1.5.1) with 8 criteria covering load_overrides from file, load_overrides from string, invalid input error, APP_NAME setting, override application, non-overridden key preservation, and deep merge sibling key preservation. Build tests: 1 test(s) run, 0 failure(s).

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260609-0003] [5.3.1.1.3] [Reporting] Group tasks by type and status in process output
description: Added tasks_by_type_status PROCESS step (df-scope, fills missing type as 'Feature', groups by type then status into a nested {type: {status: [tasks]}} dict). Added tasks_by_type_status_split OUTPUT (split:2, HTML reports per type under {$OUTPUT_PATH$}/tasks/reports). Added post test test_tasks_by_type_status (Feature 5.3.1.1.3) with 5 criteria: results_file_found, tasks_by_type_status_has_type_groups, each_type_group_is_status_dict, tasks_correctly_grouped_by_type_and_status, tasks_without_type_grouped_under_feature. Registered post_tasks_by_type_status in test/config/base.json. Added architecture entries 5.3.1.1.2 (test_tasks_by_status) and 5.3.1.1.3 (test_tasks_by_type_status) under Feature 5.3.1.1. Build test: 1 test(s) run, 0 failure(s).

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260609-0006] [6.2.1.1] [Robustness] Track conversion errors in DataConverter; fix dict source passthrough
description: DataConverter.apply() (Feature 6.2.1.1) now wraps every conversion step in try/except. Exceptions (including KeyError for a missing source column) are logged via DATAE01 and appended to self.errors; execution continues with the next step. self.errors is reset at the start of each call. DATAE01 added to resources/message_codes/base.csv. BASE-REQ-004.4 added. New prep tests: test_dataconverter_error_handling (5.3.1.3.6, 9 criteria) and test_dataconverter_json_column (5.3.1.3.7, 7 criteria, validates json.loads on ExtendedProps/Schema demo dataset). Architecture features 5.3.1.3.6, 5.3.1.3.7, 6.2.1, and 6.2.1.1 updated. Also fixed AppManager.process_data() to pass dict source values directly to DataConverter.apply() instead of silently replacing them with an empty DataFrame.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.6, 6.1.9.18, 6.1.9.19, 5.3.1.1.2, 5.3.1.3.5] [Hyperlinks, Caller Depth, Tasks By Status, Instantiation Fix] Four open tasks resolved: caller lineage from CSV, instantiation --source arg, tasks_by_status post test, HTML hyperlinks.
description: (1) caller_depth column in all message code CSVs (blank=default 2, WARN/ERROR/FAIL=4); Logger._lookup_entry returns (text, type, caller_depth); log() uses per-code depth. (2) instantiate.py --source argument added so copied scripts can point at BaseApp; improved same-path error message with actionable hint. (3) Added test_tasks_by_status (Feature 5.3.1.1.2) post test that reads results/results.json and validates each task is in the correct status group; AppManager.close() now publishes output_path to the monitor so the test can locate results. (4) HtmlDoc._as_hyperlink() detects Windows/POSIX absolute paths and http/https/file URLs; _render_cell() wraps detected values in <a href=...> anchor tags; test_html_hyperlinks (Feature 5.3.1.3.5) covers 9 criteria; registered as prep_html_hyperlinks. All prep and post tests PASS, exit 0. Also removed stray 'from pandas import col' import from utils/baseutils.py.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.11.3, 6.1.11.10, 5.3.1.3.1, 5.3.1.3.4, BASE-REQ-005.8] [OUTPUT_MAP] Renamed RESULT_MAP to OUTPUT_MAP; initialized in AppManager.__init__; deep-update semantics across calls; robust test_manager isolation.
description: Renamed self.RESULT_MAP to self.OUTPUT_MAP throughout. OUTPUT_MAP is now initialized as {} in AppManager.__init__ (not inside store_outputs), so it persists across calls and is always present on the instance. store_outputs deep-updates OUTPUT_MAP without resetting it between calls, enabling accumulation across multiple invocations. base.py uses a two-call pattern: first call stores all non-OUTPUT_MAP entries (populating OUTPUT_MAP), second call stores OUTPUT_MAP-sourced entries (output_map.json, output_map_html) using the fully populated map. test_manager.store_outputs is scoped to only the keys declared in test/config/base.json OUTPUT, preventing it from overwriting any app-managed artifacts. Fixed test_output_delta (5.3.1.3.1) to use path_join instead of os.path.join for paths used as manifest keys, ensuring forward-slash parity with the manifest on Windows. Updated config/base.json entries result_map/result_map_html renamed to output_map/output_map_html. build/requirements/base.json BASE-REQ-005.8 and breakdown updated. build/architecture/base.json features 6.1.11.10 and 5.3.1.3.4 updated. All prep tests PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.11.3, 6.1.11.9, 6.1.11.10, BASE-REQ-005.8] [store_outputs RESULT_MAP] store_outputs now populates self.RESULT_MAP with a dict mapping each output_key to the list of stored file paths, and returns it to the caller.
description: store_outputs (Feature 6.1.11.3) now initializes self.RESULT_MAP as an empty dict before processing and populates it with {output_key: [file_paths]} after each _store_one_output call in both sequential and concurrent modes. _save_output_artifact (6.1.11.8) returns the full output path whether the file was written or delta-skipped; _store_split_outputs (6.1.11.X) returns a flat list of paths; _store_one_output (6.1.11.9) returns a list of paths. store_outputs returns self.RESULT_MAP so callers can use it directly. Added config/base.json output entry result_map (source RESULT_MAP). Added prep test test_output_file_mapping (5.3.1.3.4) covering 7 criteria: dict type, key set, non-empty string lists, on-disk path existence, delta-skip retention, concurrent mode parity, and return-value identity. Added BASE-REQ-005.8 and architecture features 6.1.11.10 and 5.3.1.3.4. All 8 prep tests PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [3.2.15, 3.2.16, 11.3.3] [drop.json] Added drop manifest and pullbase drop behavior to remove deprecated paths from variant apps on every base pull.
description: Added resources/manifests/drop.json (Feature 11.3.3) listing 9 deprecated folder paths created by the v26.06.06.01 file tree refactor: docs/instructions, docs/tasks, docs/requirements, docs/architecture, docs/message_codes, docs/templates, docs/manifests, docs/version, and updates. Added load_drop_entries() (Feature 3.2.15) to pullbase.py to read the 'drop' key from copied manifest files, and drop_deprecated_paths() (Feature 3.2.16) to delete each listed path if present in the local app root. The drop step runs in main() after pull_once_files and is logged with new message codes PULL009 (loaded drop entries) and PULL010 (dropped deprecated paths). Build test 25/25 PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [3.4] [setup_env] Use 'python -m pip' instead of pip.exe to avoid broken launcher when venv Python path has changed.
description: Replaced all pip.exe invocations in scripts/setup_env.ps1 with 'python -m pip'. The pip.exe launcher embeds the absolute path to the Python interpreter used when the venv was created; if that path changes (e.g. OneDrive sync moves the folder) the launcher fails with 'Unable to create process'. Using 'python -m pip' bypasses the launcher entirely and always invokes pip through the venv's own python.exe. Renamed the PipExe parameter to PythonExe in both Get-InstalledPackageNames and Install-MissingPackages helpers; removed the $venvPip variable.

name: [BaseApp] [10.7] [Architecture] Renumbered build.updates from Feature 7 to Feature 10.7; Unicode stdout/stderr fix in baseutils.py.
description: Removed the duplicate top-level Feature 7 (build.updates) from build/architecture/base.json; the canonical location is now Feature 10.7 (renamed from 10.5) under the build Feature 10. Sub-features renumbered 10.7.1 (base.json) and 10.7.2 (app.json). Updated build/architecture/app.json to match (10.7 with 10.7.2; legacy Feature 7 scaffold removed). Added Unicode stdout/stderr reconfiguration to utils/baseutils.py so log output is safe on Windows cp1252 consoles. Build test 25/25 PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [11.4] [File Tree Refactor] Moved docs/version to resources/version; updated manifests, architecture, and all references.
description: Moved docs/version/base.txt and docs/version/app.txt to resources/version/, completing the consolidation of all shared runtime data under resources/. docs/ now holds only readme/. Updated resources/manifests/pull.json source to resources/version/base.txt and resources/manifests/once.json source to resources/version/app.txt. Added Feature 11.4 (resources.version) with 11.4.1 (base.txt) to build/architecture/base.json and 11.4.2 (app.txt) to build/architecture/app.json. Removed Feature 4.6 (docs.version) from both architecture files. Updated build/instructions/base.md and docs/readme/base.md text references. Build test 25/25 PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260605-0002] [10, 11] [File Tree Refactor] Consolidated build-related and runtime data resources into build/ and resources/ directories; updated all paths, manifests, config, and architecture.
description: Refactored the workspace file tree to consolidate build-related assets under build/ (instructions, tasks, requirements, architecture, updates) and shared runtime data resources under resources/ (message_codes, templates, manifests). docs/ now holds only readme/ and version/. pull.json entries use a target field for destination overrides; once.json entries use a destination field. scripts/pullbase.py and scripts/instantiate.py now read destination (with fallback to target) for once-manifest entries. All configuration paths in config/base.json, manifest entries in resources/manifests/pull.json and once.json, test fixtures in test/tests/base/pullbase.py, test/tests/base/base.py, test/config/base.json, scripts/test_deployment.ps1, and the architecture inventory in build/architecture/base.json and build/architecture/app.json updated to the new locations. Added BASE-REQ-013 with 7 breakdown items and full solution traceability. Build test 25/25 PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260605-0003] [6.1.17, 5.3.1.3.3] [Serialization] Promoted to_json_compatible to module-level function in baseutils; fixed test_deployment to pass venv Python executable.
description: Promoted to_json_compatible from a nested helper inside save() to a standalone module-level function (Feature 6.1.17) in utils/baseutils.py, enabling reuse across the codebase. Updated save() to call the module-level version. Added prep test test_to_json_compatible (Feature 5.3.1.3.3) with 9 criteria covering: import at module level, Params expansion, np.floating NaN/value, np.integer, np.bool_, pd.NA, DataFrame conversion, and final JSON serializability — all PASS. Added BASE-REQ-005.7 and architecture entry 6.1.17. Also fixed test_deployment (Feature 6.3.5) in testutils.py to pass sys.executable as the -Python argument to test_deployment.ps1, so the correct venv Python is used when spawning the deployment test subprocess. Build test now 25/25 PASS.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260605-0001] [3.4, 3.5, 3.1.11, 3.2.14] [Deployment Automation] Added setup_env.ps1 for venv and dependency setup, deploy.ps1 for deployment ceremony, and automatic setup_env invocation from instantiate.py and pullbase.py.
description: Added scripts/setup_env.ps1 (Feature 3.4): creates or reuses .venv, installs only missing packages from dependencies/base.txt and dependencies/app.txt via pip (Get-InstalledPackageNames + Install-MissingPackages helpers). Added scripts/deploy.ps1 (Feature 3.5): deployment ceremony with three phases — ENVIRONMENT (calls setup_env.ps1), DEPLOYMENT TEST (calls test_deployment.ps1), BUILD TESTS (calls test/tests/build.py via venv Python); aborts on environment failure and reports per-criterion PASS/FAIL summary. Added run_setup_env() to scripts/instantiate.py (Feature 3.1.11) and scripts/pullbase.py (Feature 3.2.14): both now invoke setup_env.ps1 non-interactively after their file operations, keeping the venv up to date after every instantiation and base pull. Merged BASE-REQ-011 into BASE-REQ-012 as sub-requirement 012.8 with breakdown items 012.8.1–012.8.6; added Feature 3.3.1 to BASE-REQ-012 solution.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260604-0012] [9.1, 9.2] [Dependencies Refactor] Moved requirements.txt to dependencies/base.txt and dependencies/app.txt.
description: Refactored config/requirements.txt into dependencies/base.txt (core runtime packages: numpy, scipy, pandas, tqdm) and dependencies/app.txt (empty; for variant app additions). Updated pull.json to pull dependencies/base.txt and once.json to copy dependencies/app.txt on instantiation. Added Feature 9 (dependencies folder with 9.1 base.txt and 9.2 app.txt) to the base architecture. Removed stale Feature 2.3 (config/requirements.txt) and updated the config folder description.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260604-0011] [5.3.2, 6.3.5] [Build Phase Tests] Added test/tests/build.py build runner and utils.testutils.test_deployment callable.
description: Added test/tests/build.py (Feature 5.3.2): a standalone build-phase test runner that loads runtime config and test config, merges them via build_test_config, creates a TestManager, runs run_phase('build'), stores outputs, and returns exit code 0 (pass) or 1 (fail). Added test_deployment (Feature 6.3.5) to utils/testutils.py: resolves script_path relative to base_dir, spawns pwsh -NonInteractive -File via subprocess, parses each [PASS]/[FAIL]/[WARN] output line as a structured criterion, and returns a TestManager-compatible result dict. Fixed TestManager.run_a_test to initialize the per-phase results slot on demand for any phase name not pre-seeded. Added BASE-REQ-007.5 requirement, TST008 message code, and architecture features 5.2.1.4, 5.3.2, 5.3.2.1, and 6.3.5.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260604-0003] [3.3.1] [Deployment Integration Test] Added scripts/test_deployment.ps1 PowerShell end-to-end deployment test.
description: Added scripts/test_deployment.ps1 (Feature 3.3.1): a standalone PowerShell integration test covering the full BaseApp deployment pipeline. Four phases: PRE validates required BaseApp source files; INSTANTIATE runs scripts/instantiate.py in a unique temp folder and verifies pull-manifest items, once-manifest items, and APP_NAME population; PULLBASE runs scripts/pullbase.py from the new TestApp pointing back to BaseApp as source; POST verifies final file layout and confirms config/app.json APP_NAME was not overwritten (once-manifest skip behavior). 25 per-criterion PASS/FAIL checks. Accepts -BaseAppRoot, -Python, and -KeepTemp parameters. Temp folder cleaned up automatically. Added BASE-REQ-013 requirement with breakdown and solution traceability. Updated architecture with feature 3.3 / 3.3.1.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260604-0002] [6.1.11.3, 6.1.11.9] [Concurrent Output Storage] store_outputs now writes artifacts concurrently via ThreadPoolExecutor.
description: store_outputs reads CONFIG.COMMON.OUTPUT_WORKERS (default 8); when > 1, dispatches each enabled OUTPUT entry to a ThreadPoolExecutor with up to OUTPUT_WORKERS threads. Per-worker exceptions are caught and logged as BASEW06 without aborting remaining writes. New private method _store_one_output (Feature 6.1.11.9) encapsulates resolve/convert/save for a single artifact and is callable from both the sequential loop (OUTPUT_WORKERS <= 1) and the thread pool. _output_manifest_lock (threading.Lock) added to AppManager.__init__ to serialise output_manifest reads and writes across worker threads. _save_output_artifact now acquires the lock when reading and updating the manifest entry. Prep test test_concurrent_store_outputs (Feature 5.3.1.3.2) added covering 6 criteria. Added BASEW06 message code and BASE-REQ-005.6 requirement.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260604-0001] [3.2.12, 3.2.13] [Pullbase Once Sync] Pullbase now syncs once-manifest items to existing apps.
description: pullbase.py now loads 'once' entries from all synced manifest files and copies each source file/directory to the local app only when the destination does not already exist. New functions: load_once_entries (Feature 3.2.12) reads once entries from manifests; pull_once_files (Feature 3.2.13) performs the conditional copy and returns (copied, skipped, missing_sources) counts. main() extends missing_sources with once-pull misses for unified PULLW07/PULLW08 warning reporting. Fixed PULLE07 message code typo to PULLW07. Added PULL007 and PULL008 message codes. Added BASE-REQ-008.5 requirement. Added prep test test_pullbase_once_sync covering pre/live/post scenarios.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260603-0004] [6.1.9, 6.1.11, 6.2.1] [Infrastructure Fixes] Fixed Logger CSV to append-only, removed _to_raw_data JSON parsing heuristic, completed DataFrameConverter custom scope.
description: Logger._write_csv now appends only new log entries on each call using a _csv_written_count counter instead of rewriting the entire file, and pre-serializes dict/list column values to JSON strings before writing. AppManager._to_raw_data no longer auto-parses strings starting with { or [ via json.loads; strings are returned as-is. Removed _json_parse_stats tracking and BASE011 log from store_outputs. Removed BASE011 and BASEW11 message codes (no longer generated). DataFrameConverter.apply custom scope evaluates op expressions against context dict and returns raw results. These changes complete task BASE-TASK-260603-0004 and eliminate spurious BASEW11 warnings and the pandas C-level crash from unserialised column values.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260603-0004] [6.1.12] [Task Report Processing] Added config-driven task grouping by status with data conversion and status-based output reports.
description: Added config.PROCESS step tasks_grouped_by_status with custom conversion that transforms raw tasks input dict into status-keyed groups. Added OUTPUT configurations tasks_by_status_split and tasks_by_status_html that render each status group to separate JSON and HTML files under tasks/reports folder. Added BASE-REQ-011 requirement capturing task report grouping and status-based distribution capability through built-in process mechanism.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260603-0002] [6.1.11.1] [Requirements/Tasks IO] Added requirements and tasks as runtime input and HTML output artifacts.
description: Added INPUT sources for docs/requirements and docs/tasks and added requirements_split_html/tasks_split_html outputs in config/base.json. Updated post-run test checks to verify requirements_loaded and tasks_loaded monitor flags.

name: [BaseApp] [BASE-TASK-260603-0001] [3.1.1] [Manifest Governance] Added requirements/tasks artifacts to manifests and established requirements baselines.
description: Added docs/requirements/base.json and docs/requirements/req-eng-instructions.md to pull.json; added docs/requirements/app.json to once.json; added docs/tasks/base.json and docs/tasks/template.json to pull.json; added docs/tasks/app.json to once.json. Replaced requirements placeholders with reverse-engineered requirement hierarchies for base and app, then finalized version metadata across config/base.json, config/app.json, and docs/version files.

name: [BaseApp] [5.3.1.1.1] [Architecture Compliance] Achieved full architecture alignment (0/0/0) and expanded base inventory.
description: Added all missing architecture entries to docs/architecture/base.json: scripts.instantiate and scripts.pullbase helper functions; Params, HtmlDoc, Logger, and AppManager public methods; module-level baseutils helpers (get_config, tryeval, try_except, add_to_dict, as_list); DataFrameConverter.apply and DataLoader.load; TestManager public methods (mark_app_state, request_store, run_phase, start_live, stop_live, finalize, run_a_test); docs/manifests, docs/instructions, docs/readme leaf files; new top-level updates folder and README.md. Added updates/app.json to docs/architecture/app.json. Removed transient Logger.log block-level sub-features. Comparator now skips __init__.py, dotfiles, and dot-folders (e.g. .git, .vscode), and resolves JSON-pointer architecture paths of the form file.json::dotted.key. Final report: MissingInCode=0, MissingInArch=0, Mismatches=0.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.9.18] [Logger] Added caller lineage to every log entry.
description: Logger.log now records the call-stack lineage (file, module, class, function, line) for every entry using inspect-based stack walking. Added a 'caller' column to log_columns and a _get_caller_lineage helper. This makes it possible to trace which call site emitted any given log entry, which was used to diagnose duplicate output writes and TESTING-config contamination of base config artifacts.

name: [BaseApp] [5.1.1] [Test Config] Routed test outputs to a dedicated TESTS_RESULTS folder.
description: test/config/base.json now overrides COMMON.OUTPUT_PATH to {$OUTPUT_PREFIX$}/{$OUTPUT_VERSION$}/TESTS_RESULTS so TestManager.store_outputs no longer overwrites the main app's config.json / config.html sibling artifacts. build_test_config re-runs evaluate+populate after dict_merge so the override propagates to all dependent test-output paths.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.11.3] [Output Storage] Added checksum-manifest delta mode to output storage.
description: Added an output-level `delta` flag handled by `_save_output_artifact` backed by a content-checksum manifest. AppManager holds an in-memory `output_manifest` dict (loaded from `<OUTPUT_PATH>/manifest.json` at init) keyed by full artifact path with `{sha256, mtime}` values. On every save in delta mode, the data is hashed (canonical JSON sha256); if the existing file's mtime matches the manifest entry AND the new checksum equals the stored sha256, the save is skipped and BASE003 is logged with `skipped: true, delta: true, sha256: <hash>`. Otherwise the artifact is written, the manifest entry is updated, and the manifest is flushed to disk so subsequent process restarts can reuse it. Applies per leaf for split outputs. Also restored the missing `save_kwargs` initialization so output saves work end-to-end.

name: [BaseApp] [6.1.11.1] [Input Loading] Added delta mode to input reading.
description: Added an input-level `delta` flag handled by DataLoader: when enabled, the loader rescans the input surface on every call and only loads files that are new or whose on-disk mtime changed since the previous load. AppManager persists a per-input last_modified map across cycles, enabling fast cyclic / periodic scanning of large input stores and automatic pickup of modified files. BASE012 now reports delta and skipped counters.

name: [BaseApp] [5.3.1.1] [Architecture Compliance] Moved suggested architecture JSON outputs into the test results folder.
description: Updated the architecture compliance prep test so suggested architecture change JSON files and the report are saved under {$OUTPUT_PATH$}/tests/results/architecture_changes, while the HTML review artifacts remain in the architecture review folder.

name: [BaseApp] [5.3.1.1] [Architecture Compliance] Added path-aware architecture metadata, a class-based architecture compliance prep test, generated HTML review artifacts, and updated the app entrypoint for direct Python execution.
description: Added path metadata to docs/architecture base and app inventories, moved architecture compliance validation into test/tests/base/base.py as an AppManager-backed class, updated the test runner to support class construction from normal test inputs, generated combined-architecture and code-tree HTML review artifacts, and added a shebang to app/app.py for direct interpreter resolution.

name: [BaseApp] Logger-Backed Test Monitoring
description: Updated the test framework to derive test config from the integrated runtime config, use the main logger data_map as the monitoring channel, publish lightweight runtime state from the app for post-run checks, and persist explicit failing test ids, failure counts, and traceback context in test results.

name: [BaseApp] Built-In Test Framework
description: Added a config-driven test framework with prep, live, and post phases, a dedicated PASS/NOTE/FAIL test logger, a thread-safe runtime monitor, and persisted test artifacts under the standard output pipeline.

name: [BaseApp] Split Output Artifacts
description: Added output split support for single-layer and multi-layer dict outputs, including dotted source resolution and per-key artifact storage using either nested folders plus file or format-based leaf filenames.

name: [BaseApp] Nested HTML Table Widths
description: Updated the dataset_table template so nested tables render at content width for better readability of small complex values while the top-level output table remains full width.

name: [BaseApp] HTML Item Enumeration Column
description: Updated HtmlDoc to add a leading item enumeration column to top-level and nested rendered tables.

name: [BaseApp] HTML Value Type Column
description: Updated HtmlDoc dict rendering to add a type column after key, including item counts for list values and key counts for dict values.

name: [BaseApp] Converter Logging Hook
description: Updated DataFrameConverter to use an injectable logging function instead of direct print calls, defaulting to print when verbose mode is enabled.

name: [BaseApp] Step Target Driven Process Output
description: Updated DataFrameConverter so df-scope process conversions run without a conversion-level target and the step target controls where the final result is stored on results.

name: [BaseApp] Config Driven DataFrame Processing
description: Added config.process support so sequential DataFrameConverter steps can transform results data, including a default step that concatenates message_codes into message_codes_df.

name: [BaseApp] Unified Input File Map Loading
description: Refactored DataLoader to build a key:path map first and run one concurrent loading flow for single files and folders alike, using basenames for direct file inputs and relative paths for folder inputs.

name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Basename Keys
description: Updated single-file config.input loading to keep results keyed by file basename, for example updates.base.json, instead of using the dummy '.' key or returning the payload directly.

name: [BaseApp] Single File Input Shape Fix
description: Kept updates/base.json as a config.input source and removed the dummy '.' key from single-file loads by keying file results explicitly instead.

name: [BaseApp] Recursive JSON Field Materialization
description: Updated output serialization to recursively parse JSON-like string fields (including DataFrame rows) into native objects and added parse diagnostics (BASE011/BASEW11).

name: [BaseApp] Message Codes And Project-Dir Pathing
description: Switched default message dictionary paths to docs/message_codes and aligned relative path resolution to the app/project directory for logger message lookup and config.input DataLoader sources.

name: [BaseApp] Generic Input Data Loader
description: Added load_data flow to process all config.input entries where load=true, storing each dataset under results.{target} with file and folder path support.

name: [BaseApp] Script Message Lookup Paths
description: Fixed instantiate and pullbase messages_dir resolution to load message CSVs from config-relative docs/messages so message code text/type lookup works.

name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Logger Init Fallback
description: Added explicit console output when pullbase logger initialization fails, preventing silent logging disablement.

name: [BaseApp] Trackit Runtime Orchestration
description: Introduced Config runtime loader, renamed decorator to trackit, and updated run() to initialize config/logger then log execute tracking output with function, result, and metrics.duration_seconds.

name: [BaseApp] Run Timeit Decorator
description: Added a reusable timeit decorator and applied it to run() so total runtime is logged with message code BASE005.

name: [BaseApp] Logger Data Column
description: Updated Logger.log signature to use data payload and store caller key:value metadata in a single CSV data column instead of dynamic parsed columns.

name: [BaseApp] Logger Dynamic Fields
description: Added Logger.log fields support so caller-supplied key:value data is mapped to dynamic CSV columns and populated only on relevant rows.

name: [BaseApp] Pullbase Local App Logs
description: Updated pullbase logging to use local app identity and output path C:/data/{local_app}/{date}/basepulls/{local_app}_{timestamp}.(csv|html).

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Base Config Only
description: Updated instantiate runtime config loading to use only base.json (no app.json override) for path and logging resolution.

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Fixed Log Path
description: Updated instantiate logging output to C:/data/BaseApp/instantiations/{date}/{target_app}_{timestamp}.csv and matching HTML path.

name: [BaseApp] Instantiate Pullbase Logging
description: Added CSV+HTML logging to instantiate (base logs_path/instantiations, {target_app}_{timestamp}) and pullbase (app logs_path/basepulls, {base_app}_{timestamp}).

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Folder Source Sync
description: Added support for manifest entries whose source is a folder; instantiate and pullbase now sync all files recursively with optional target folder mapping.

name: [BaseApp] Key Driven Manifest Folder
description: Updated instantiate and pullbase to consume all JSON files from docs/manifests and apply behavior by key: instantiate uses once+pull, pullbase uses pull.

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Source Target Schema
description: Updated instantiate and pullbase manifest parsing to use section lists of items with required source and optional target defaulting to source.

name: [BaseApp] Scripts And Manifest Dict
description: Moved instantiate and pullbase into scripts/ and updated manifests to dict format with pull and once sections under docs/manifests.

name: [BaseApp] Manifest Location Refactor
description: Moved instantiate and pull manifests to docs/manifests (pull.json and once.json) and updated instantiate.py and pullbase.py to consume the new paths.
